eventDetail.eventTitle: 2026 IEEE 1st International Conference on Advanced Sensing for Embodied Perception and Physical AI (EPIC)
eventDetail.about: Bioengineering; Components, Circuits, Devices and Systems; Computing and Processing; Robotics and Control Systems
eventDetail.sponsors: City University of Hong Kong - CityU; IEEE Nanotechnology Council
eventDetail.scope: Novel sensing modalities and transducers (micro/nano, flexible, photonic, biochemical)  Sensor materials, fabrication, and packaging (MEMS/NEMS, nanofab, integration)  Wearable, implantable, and epidermal sensors  Tactile, force/torque, and proprioceptive sensing for robots LiDAR, radar, ultrasonic, and acoustic sensing  Multimodal sensing and sensor fusion  Edge sensing systems and embedded/low-power  AI (TinyML, neuromorphic) Sensor interfaces, readout circuits, and mixed-signal systems  Energy harvesting, power management, and self-powered sensing  Perception for embodied intelligence (state estimation, SLAM, tracking)  Perception–action learning and closed-loop control  Robot learning from demonstration and human-in-the-loop sensing  Human–robot interaction and intent recognition (multisensory HRI)  Privacy, security, and trustworthy sensing (on-device processing, federated learning)  Healthcare and assistive applications (rehab, elder care, monitoring, hospital robotics)
